Two gaps at the same boundary, both measured against `php -n` 8.5.6.

AN EMPTY ARRAY PASSED BY REFERENCE.

```php
function fill(array &$a): void { $a[] = 1; $a[] = 2; }
$e = []; fill($e); echo count($e), ":", implode(",", $e);
```

php prints `2:1,2`. This backend SEGFAULTED before the by-reference widening
landed, and answered `2:` after it — the count was right and every element read
